title: Expected Nitro Enclave measurements
description: Written by infra/scripts/build-eif.sh. The SDK compares the PCRs in each live attestation document with these values. See infra/README.md, section 'pcrs.json for the SDK team'.

pcr.description: Lowercase hex SHA-384, 96 characters. All zeros means debug mode and must be rejected.

pcr0.description: Hash of the whole enclave image. The SDK MUST check this.

pcr1.description: Hash of the Linux kernel and boot ramdisk. Changes with the nitro-cli version.

imageId.description: Docker image ID the EIF was built from. Informational.

gitCommit.description: Commit the image was built from. A '-dirty' suffix means uncommitted changes; do not publish those.

reproducibilityChecked.description: True if build-eif.sh --check rebuilt without cache and got the same PCR0.
